proof_body:
by
  intro K V _ _ _ _ _ _ f
  haveI : Nontrivial (Module.Dual K V) := by
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := exists_ne (0 : V)
    by_contra hn
    rw [not_nontrivial_iff_subsingleton] at hn
    exact hx ((Module.forall_dual_apply_eq_zero_iff K x).mp fun φ => by rw [Subsingleton.elim φ 0]; rfl)
  obtain ⟨μ, hμ⟩ := Module.End.exists_eigenvalue (LinearMap.dualMap f : Module.End K (Module.Dual K V))
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ⟩ := hμ.exists_hasEigenvector
  have hφ0 : φ ≠ 0 := hφ.2
  have hfφ : ∀ x, φ (f x) = μ * φ x := fun x => by
    have := LinearMap.congr_fun hφ.apply_eq_smul x
    simpa using this
  refine ⟨LinearMap.ker φ, ?_, fun x hx => ?_⟩
  · have hsurj : LinearMap.range φ = ⊤ := LinearMap.range_eq_top.mpr (LinearMap.surjective hφ0)
    have h := LinearMap.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker φ
    rw [hsurj, finrank_top, Module.finrank_self] at h
    omega
  · rw [LinearMap.mem_ker] at hx ⊢
    rw [hfφ, hx, mul_zero]
target_source: ∀ (K V : Type*) [Field K] [IsAlgClosed K] [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] [FiniteDimensional K V] [Nontrivial V] (f : Module.End K V), ∃ W : Submodule K V, Module.finrank K W + 1 = Module.finrank K V ∧ ∀ x ∈ W, f x ∈ W
